text:
maya: Heads-up — change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Can we run a fast preflight checklist here? :eyes:
thomas: I'm on it. canary warmup started on shard A. will post status.
deploy-bot: canary deployment initiated -> service: inference-api, image: rwd-infer:v3.2.1-canary
liam: quick checklist from infra side: 
- GPU pool health: OK
- Disk pressure: OK
- Network fabric: 1/1 healthy
anna: API smoke tests queued. running the small prompt suite now.
ops-bot: smoke-tests: 12/12 passed (latency median 78ms, p95 210ms)
thomas: canary pinned to v3.2.1-canary for 30m to observe. routing weight 5%.
maya: good. document pin and rollback owners in case we need to unwind. liam you own rollback?
liam: I'll own rollback. manual-unpin manhole procedure ready in runbook, steps and contact list included.
liam: manual-unpin steps summary: 
1) set routing weight to 0
2) trigger deploy-bot unpin command `deploy-bot unpin inference-api`
3) verify traffic shift and evict caches
4) if any step fails, open incident and escalate to oncall ENG-SRE
sasha: added a quick snippet to runbook for force-unpin in case deploy-bot is unresponsive: 
```
kubectl -n rwd rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=42
kubectl -n rwd patch svc inference-api -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"inference-api-stable"}}}'
```
maya: perfect. add the expected monitoring checks to confirm rollback: error-rate <= 0.5% and latency p95 < 300ms.
anna: noted. I'll run release notes checklist: docs updated, changelog entry, deprecation notes for old quant kernels.
thomas: double-checking model pin matrix: hosted customers pinned to v3.1.x until 23:00 UTC tomorrow, Dedicated unaffected.
maya: final go/no-go at T-minus 15. If any smoke fails, we abort and follow rollback lane.
deploy-bot: scheduled promotion in 15m -> action: promote canary to stable if no abort flag set.
liam: I'll be watching metrics and ready to execute manual-unpin if needed. ping me with `@liam rollback` to trigger.
maya: thanks team. one more ask — ops: can we enable the debug logs for 10 min post-promote to catch regressions?
ops-bot: debug logs enabled for inference-api for 10m post-promotion. retention set low, artifacts go to ephemeral storage.
sasha: leaving a tiny postmortem template in the thread in case we need it: one-liner impact, root cause, rollback time, follow-ups.
maya: awesome. T-minus 15 heads-up coming in 10. :thumbsup:
